text:
Cassie P: FYI folks — Port Authority just put the harbor on high-wind hold, ferries inbound 7:30-9:00 canceled. Link: https://harbor.example/status :ship: :wind_face:
Jordan M: Oh man. I planned to ferry today. Guess I'll try the bridge but heard the slow lane is closed.
Izzy R: If anyone wants a scooter, I have an extra Lime unlocked near Embarcadero. Might be sketchy in gusts though.
Paul G: @Izzy R appreciate it but no thanks on the scooter in gale conditions. I'll offer a lift instead 5th & Market at 8:10, two seats.
TransitBot: Alert: Ferry routes F1/F2 suspended due to hazardous winds. Bay Bridge slow lane closed for debris removal. Expect 20-40 minute delays across major corridors.
WeatherBot: Gale warning until 10:30. Peak gusts 45-55 mph near waterfront. Small craft advisory and flying-debris risk.
Cassie P: Thanks @Paul G 045th & Market pickup noted. Also kitchen note — sugar is out. Emergency cookie protocol failing.
Jordan M: I'll take a seat @Paul G if it's okay. Can Venmo gas.
Izzy R: Meme: "Me checking commute maps like it's a strategy game" :joy: (posted GIF)
Paul G: @Jordan M sure. Leaving at 8:05 so plan for 8:20 arrival.
TransitBot: Tip: Consider BART + shuttle for predictable travel times; ferries and surface routes most affected.
Cassie P: Quick poll: standup 09:50 remote or hold in person? Reply "remote" or "office".
Jordan M: office (but may be tardy)
Izzy R: remote 5ceiling of safety
Paul G: office (will try to be on time)
WeatherBot: Reminder: a handful of traffic signals along Embarcadero are flashing due to outages. Use extra caution.
Cassie P: Also, if anyone's coming in and wants to stash wet shoes, reception has a towel box. Don't leave puddles on desks. :sweat_drops:
Jordan M: Thanks for the heads up. If ferries resume I'll ping this thread. Stay safe everyone.
Izzy R: If anyone wants the scooter code DM me, but please be sensible.
Paul G: Bringing an extra umbrella to leave at reception. See y'all.
